assistant|home_studio_lighting: Use soft, indirect natural light near a window or a basic key/fill/backlight kit; softboxes minimize harsh shadows
assistant|home_studio_mic: USB microphones Blue Yeti or Rode NT-USB recommended; place 6-8 inches from mouth, slightly off-center
assistant|home_studio_noise: Reduce background noise with a quiet room, pop filter, or DIY mesh screen
assistant|home_studio_camera: Use a smartphone or DSLR/mirrorless camera with good low-light performance, on a tripod
assistant|home_studio_framing: Frame medium shot (waist-up) or close-up (head and shoulders), centered
assistant|home_studio_background: Use a plain, neutral-colored background such as a white or gray wall
assistant|recording_software: Free: OBS Studio (PC) or QuickTime (Mac); paid: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve
assistant|recording_tips: Rehearse, record in a single take, use an external hard drive, and monitor audio with headphones
assistant|video_postproduction: Keep editing simple, add captions, and optimize keywords/tags/description for YouTube
